source_grounding_policy.principle: Read Bulkowski source first, write source contract second, then scanner/PDF. Shared code may cover statistics/rendering only; geometry, target, quality and narrative remain family/pattern/variant-specific.
source_grounding_policy.final_gate: source_notes.status PASS, at least 6 source_rules, and no high/medium source-grounding issues before final publication

publication_semantic_policy.principle: A final public chapter must have a dedicated publication spec and must read like an investor-facing chapter, not an internal rendered payload.
publication_semantic_policy.final_gate: publication_spec.status PASS, no raw source-rule text, no internal terms, and no generic_family spec for pattern/variant finals

flag_like_family.family_rule: Flags, Pennants, and High-and-Tight Flags share continuation statistics only. Geometry, target calibration, quality tiers, and narrative remain pattern-specific.

bull_pennants.quality_gate: Converging trendline body, steep prior advance, close breakout, calibrated target bands, and manual visual review before any final promotion

bear_pennants.quality_gate: Converging trendline body, steep prior decline, close breakout, calibrated target bands, and manual visual review before any final promotion

high_tight_flags.quality_gate: Dedicated detector must require near-doubling in under two months, short high consolidation, upward breakout, and half-prior-move target logic

triangle_family.family_rule: Reuse only the shared statistical/publication core. Keep scanner geometry, target calibration, quality tiers, and example policy pattern-specific.

triangles_ascending.chapter_lane: investment-reference candidate under available-series public-grade scope
triangles_ascending.quality_gate: premium visual validation scored_n >= 30, median >= 4, pass_rate >= 70

triangles_descending.chapter_lane: defensive/informational reference candidate; headline scope must be branch-filtered, not aggregate
triangles_descending.quality_gate: premium visual validation pass; branch headline required because aggregate MFE/MAE is weak

triangles_symmetrical.chapter_lane: watchlist-reference branch candidate; headline scope must be direction-filtered, not aggregate
triangles_symmetrical.quality_gate: direction-first headline required; current public chapter uses up breakout x mid liquidity x premium/standard because aggregate up/down is invalid

double_pattern_family.family_rule: Reuse only the shared statistical/publication core. Keep reversal geometry, neckline confirmation, Adam/Eve variant logic, target rules, and example policy pattern/variant-specific.

double_bottoms_adam_adam.quality_gate: source-grounded variant contract required before any final promotion

double_bottoms_adam_eve.quality_gate: Chapter 14 source contract required; no inherited Adam & Adam source wording

wedge_family.family_rule: Reuse only the shared statistical/publication core. Keep wedge geometry, same-direction converging trendlines, breakout side, target calibration, quality tiers, and example policy pattern-specific.

wedges_falling.quality_gate: source-grounded Wedge contract and public-grade statistical gate before final promotion

wedges_rising.chapter_lane: defensive/informational reference candidate under available-series scope
wedges_rising.quality_gate: source-grounded Wedge contract and public-grade statistical gate before final promotion

broadening_bottoms.reason: Outdated V2 logic is no longer the standard for matrix-based pattern expansion.
